title: Kimiyya da fasaha
description: Ten short stories and texts about science and technology: a Kano scientist's doctorate on an HIV medicine, a young metal caster in Zaria and his invention, a grandmother in Katsina who once queued for the post office telephone and now sees her grandson play cricket in London on video, a radio reporter who checks phone videos of election rigging in Gombe, the Prime Minister of Niger touring a huge solar plant, a vet operating on a leopard at the Kano zoo, a scholar and his student sighting the Sallah moon with a telescope in Sokoto, a column on how phones and satellites help free trafficked girls, a girl's epilepsy blamed on jinn in Katsina, and two friends at a school science fair in Kaduna.

lessons.title: Digirin digirgir na Dr. Nazifa
lessons.summary: In Kano, Dr. Nazifa, a gifted girl who became a doctor, returns from England with a doctorate on HIV/AIDS; with Professor Imrana, a Kano native who founded the research unit, she seeks an injection that lasts six months, finds that one version damages the liver of the mice, changes it and presents her results in Abuja.
lessons.text:
Nazifa ta tashi a Kano. Mahaifinta haifaffen Zaria ne, amma ya zauna a Kano tun yana saurayi. Tun tana makarantar firamare malamanta suke cewa ita haziƙa ce. Ta fi kowa a ajinsu a lissafi da kimiyya.

Bayan ta gama karatun likitanci a Kano, ta tafi Ingila domin ta yi digirin digirgir. Ta shafe shekara huɗu tana bincike a kan cutar kanjamau. Kanjamau cuta ce da take rage ƙarfin garkuwar jiki, har sauran cututtuka su kama mutum cikin sauƙi.

Da ta dawo gida da digirin digirgir ɗinta, ta fara aiki a sashen binciken kanjamau na wani babban asibiti a Kano. Shugaban sashen shi ne Farfesa Imrana, wanda shi ma haifaffen Kano ne. Shi ne ya kafa sashen shekara 20 da suka wuce. Ya ce mata, "Magabatanmu a wannan aiki sun yi ƙoƙari sosai. Yanzu ɗawainiyar ta koma kanku, ku matasa."

Magungunan kanjamau da ake da su yanzu ba sa warkar da cutar kacokan. Suna rage ƙwayar cutar a cikin jini, amma dole mai cutar ya sha su kowace rana har ƙarshen rayuwarsa. Idan ya daina, cutar za ta dawo. Wannan ɗawainiya ce mai nauyi ga mara lafiya.

Nazifa tana neman maganin da zai dawwama a jiki: allura ɗaya da za ta yi aiki har wata shida. Aikin yana da sarƙaƙiya, domin ƙwayar cutar tana ɓoye a cikin wasu ƙwayoyin jiki. Kuma kafin a ba mutane kowane sabon magani, dole a tabbatar ba shi da lahani.

Suka gwada maganin a kan ɓeraye. Bayan wata biyu, wasu ɓerayen sun yi ciwon hanta. Wannan babban lahani ne. Nazifa ta yi baƙin ciki, amma Farfesa Imrana ya ce, "Kimiyya haka take. Babu aiki mai sarƙaƙiya da ake gama shi a rana ɗaya. Magabatanmu ma sun sha wahala kafin su yi nasara."

Nazifa ta canza wani sinadari a cikin maganin. Ta sake gwadawa. Bayan wata takwas, sabon maganin ya dawwama a jikin ɓerayen har kwana 90, kuma bai yi musu wani lahani ba.

Ta gabatar da sakamakon a wani babban taro a Abuja. Wani likita ya tambaye ta, "Wannan maganin zai warkar da kanjamau kacokan?" Ta ce, "A'a, tukuna. Amma zai rage wa masu cutar wahalar shan magani kowace rana."

Bayan taron, Farfesa Imrana ya ce mata, "Na yi farin ciki da ganin cewa ɗawainiyar wannan aiki tana hannun haziƙan matasa irinki."

Tambayoyi:
Ina Nazifa ta yi digirin digirgir?
Ta yi digirin digirgir a Ingila.
Wane ne ya kafa sashen binciken kanjamau?
Farfesa Imrana, haifaffen Kano, shi ne ya kafa shi.
Me ya sa magungunan da ake da su suke da wahala?
Domin ba sa warkar da cutar kacokan, dole a sha su kowace rana.
Wane lahani maganin farko ya yi?
Wasu ɓeraye sun yi ciwon hanta.
Har kwana nawa sabon maganin ya dawwama a jikin ɓerayen?
Ya dawwama har kwana 90.
Me malaman Nazifa suke cewa a kanta tun tana firamare?
Suna cewa ita haziƙa ce.

lessons.title: Tukwanen Jawad
lessons.summary: In Zaria, the young Jawad works with his uncle Malam Talle melting old metal in a brick furnace burning coal; with three days left for an order of fifty pots the first day gives zero good pots because the fire is weak, so Jawad invents a bicycle-wheel blower, and they finish with only one cracked pot and clean the workshop.
lessons.text:
Jawad matashi ne ɗan shekara 19 a Zaria. Yana aiki tare da kawunsa, Malam Talle, a wani ƙaramin wurin aiki a bayan kasuwa. Aikinsu shi ne narkar da tsofaffin kayan ƙarfe, kamar tukwane da suka fashe da sassan motoci, domin su yi sababbin tukwane da su.

Wurin narkar da ƙarfen murhu ne babba da aka gina da tubali. Malam Talle ya ce tubali yana riƙe zafi fiye da laka. A cikin murhun suna ƙona kwal. Kwal yana ba da zafi mai yawa fiye da itace, amma hayaƙinsa yana da yawa.

Wata rana wani ɗan kasuwa ya zo ya ce, "Ina son tukwane 50 kafin ranar Alhamis. Zan biya ku rabin kuɗin yau." Malam Talle ya karɓa. Saura kwana uku kawai.

A rana ta farko, sun ƙona kwal da yawa, amma ƙarfen bai narke sosai ba. Duk tukwanen da suka zuba sun fashe. Da yamma Jawad ya ƙirga tukwanen da suka yi kyau. Sifili. Babu ko ɗaya. Malam Talle ya ce, "Wutar ba ta da ƙarfi. Iska ba ta shiga murhun sosai."

Jawad ya kwana yana tunani. Lokaci yana ƙure musu. Da safe ya ɗauko wani tsohon keke. Ya cire tayarsa, ya haɗa ƙafar keken da wani bututu da yake shiga ƙasan murhun. Duk lokacin da ya juya ƙafar, iska tana shiga cikin wutar. Haka ya kago sabuwar hanyar hura wuta da kansa.

Suka sake ƙona kwal. Jawad yana juya ƙafar keke, wutar tana ƙara zafi har kwal ɗin ya yi ja kamar rana. Ƙarfen ya fara narkewa cikin ƙanƙanin lokaci. Malam Talle ya yi mamaki. Ya ce, "Wa ya koya maka wannan?" Jawad ya ce, "Babu kowa. Ni na kago shi."

A wannan rana sun yi tukwane 30. Ɗaya tak ta tsage. Washegari suka yi aiki tun asuba. Lokaci ya kusa ƙure, amma da yamma sun ƙarasa sauran tukwane 20. Da sun ƙarasa, suka goge kowace tukunya, suka jera su a ƙasa.

Ranar Alhamis ɗan kasuwar ya zo. Ya ƙirga tukwane 50. Ya ce, "Na ga ɗaya tak tana da tsagewa. Sauran duka suna da kyau." Ya biya su sauran kuɗin.

Bayan ya tafi, Malam Talle da Jawad suka share wurin aikin tsaf. Suka jera tubali a gefe tsaf, suka ajiye sauran kwal a cikin buhu. Malam Talle ya ce, "Daga yau, kai ne injiniyan wannan wuri."

Tambayoyi:
Da me aka gina murhun Malam Talle?
An gina shi da tubali.
Tukwane nawa suka yi kyau a rana ta farko?
Sifili, babu ko ɗaya.
Me Jawad ya kago?
Ya kago hanyar hura wuta da ƙafar tsohon keke.
Tukunya nawa ta tsage a rana ta biyu?
Ɗaya tak ta tsage.
Me Malam Talle da Jawad suke narkar da shi?
Suna narkar da tsofaffin kayan ƙarfe, kamar tukwane da suka fashe.
Me suka yi bayan ɗan kasuwar ya tafi?
Suka share wurin aikin tsaf.

lessons.title: Tarho a gidan waya
lessons.summary: In Katsina, Hajiya Saukatu remembers how long ago she said goodbye to her son Ziyad at Kano airport and then queued once a month to use the post office telephone; now a granddaughter sets up a video call, and her grandson Amir in London greets her and shows her how cricket is played.
lessons.text:
Hajiya Saukatu tsohuwa ce a Katsina. Tuntuni, shekara 30 da suka wuce, ɗanta Ziyad ya tafi Landan domin karatu. Ta raka shi har filin jirgin sama na Kano. A can suka yi bankwana. Da Ziyad yana shiga jirgi, ya waiwaya ya ɗaga mata hannu. Ita ma ta ɗaga masa hannu, tana kuka.

A wancan sa'i babu wayar hannu. A Katsina duka akwai tarho kaɗan kawai, kuma mafi yawansu suna gidan waya. Sau ɗaya a wata, Hajiya Saukatu takan je gidan waya da sassafe, ta yi layi tare da sauran mutane. Takan yini a can wani lokaci kafin lokacinta ya zo.

Idan ta kama tarho, sai ta ji muryar Ziyad daga nesa, kamar daga cikin rijiya. Takan ce, "Ziyad, ina yini?" Shi kuma ya ce, "Lafiya lau, Inna." Minti uku kawai suke magana, domin kuɗin tarho yana da tsada. Bayan sun yi bankwana, takan koma gida cike da bege. Bege ya hana ta barci a daren.

Yanzu Ziyad yana da aure da yara a Landan. Ɗansa Amir yana da shekara 12. Ziyad yakan aiko wa mahaifiyarsa kuɗi, amma ba ta taɓa ganin jikanta ba sai a hoto.

Wata rana jikarta, 'yar 'yarta, ta zo da sabuwar waya. Ta ce, "Kaka, yau za ki ga Amir a cikin waya." Hajiya Saukatu ta ce, "Ah! A cikin waya kuma?" Yarinyar ta danna wayar, sai fuskar Amir ta bayyana.

Amir ya ce, "Kaka, ina yini?" Hajiya Saukatu ta ce, "Ah! Na'am, ɗana, lafiya lau." Ta riƙe wayar kusa da fuskarta. Ta ce, "Kana ganina?" Amir ya ce, "Na'am, Kaka, ina ganinki sosai."

Amir yana sanye da fararen kaya, yana riƙe da wani dogon katako. Ta tambaye shi, "Me ke nan a hannunka?" Ya ce, "Wannan na kurket ne. Muna wasan kurket a makaranta." Ya juya wayar, ta ga yara suna gudu a cikin fili. Ya bayyana mata yadda ake buga ƙwallon kurket da katako. Ta ce, "Ah, wasan Turawa ke nan."

Suka yi magana na tsawon awa ɗaya, ba tare da an biya ko sisi ba. Bayan sun yi bankwana, Hajiya Saukatu ta waiwaya ta kalli jikarta. Ta ce, "Tuntuni, a sa'in da nake layi a gidan waya, ban taɓa tunanin wannan zai yiwu ba." Wannan karon, ba ta kwana da bege ba.

Tambayoyi:
Ina Hajiya Saukatu da Ziyad suka yi bankwana?
Sun yi bankwana a filin jirgin sama na Kano.
Ina tarho suke a wancan sa'i?
Mafi yawansu suna gidan waya.
Me ya sa minti uku kawai suke magana?
Domin kuɗin tarho yana da tsada.
Wane wasa Amir yake yi a makaranta?
Yana wasan kurket.
Me Hajiya Saukatu ta ce bayan sun yi bankwana?
Ta ce tuntuni ba ta taɓa tunanin wannan zai yiwu ba.

lessons.title: Bidiyon maguɗi
lessons.summary: In Gombe, on election day, thugs snatch ballot boxes and voters film them on their phones; the candidate Alhaji Ɗanmalam calls the videos lies on the radio, so the reporter Usama investigates their times and places and a thug's face, the police arrest the thugs, young people march, and the rival party challenges the result in court.
lessons.text:
Usama ɗan jarida ne a wani gidan rediyo a Gombe. A ranar zaɓen gwamna, ya zagaya rumfunan zaɓe yana ɗaukar rahoto. Da tsakar rana, wasu matasa sun kira shi a waya. Sun ce, "'Yan daba sun zo rumfarmu da adduna, sun kwashe akwatunan zaɓe, sun gudu da su."

Da yamma, bidiyo da dama suka bazu a kafafen sada zumunta. A cikinsu ana ganin 'yan daba suna kwashe akwatuna, suna saka su a cikin wata mota. Mutane suka ce wannan maguɗi ne, domin an yi shi ne don wani ɗan takara, Alhaji Ɗanmalam, ya ci zaɓen.

Washegari Alhaji Ɗanmalam ya yi magana a rediyo. Ya ce, "Babu maguɗin da aka yi. Waɗannan bidiyoyin ƙarya ne. Wanda ya yi su maƙaryaci ne." Ya ƙalubalanci 'yan jarida a bainar jama'a cewa su kawo shaida.

Usama ya ce wa editansa, "Zan bi diddigin waɗannan bidiyoyi." Ya tattara bidiyo 12. Ya duba bayanan da wayoyin suka ajiye a cikin kowane bidiyo: lokacin da aka ɗauke shi da wurin da aka ɗauke shi. Duka suna nuna rumfuna uku a unguwa ɗaya, a tsakanin ƙarfe ɗaya da ƙarfe biyu na rana.

Ya ci gaba da bin diddigi. A wani bidiyo, fuskar wani ɗan daba ta fito sarai. Mutanen unguwar sun san shi. Suka ce shi ɗan rakiyar Alhaji Ɗanmalam ne. Usama ya kuma gano lambar motar da aka saka akwatunan a ciki.

Usama ya ba da rahotonsa a rediyo. Badaƙalar ta bazu a duk faɗin jihar. Mutane suka ce, "Yanzu mun san wane ne maƙaryaci." Matasa sun yi muzahara a kan titunan Gombe. Suka riƙe takardu da aka rubuta, "A'a ga maguɗi!" Muzaharar ta tafi lafiya, ba tare da faɗa ba.

'Yan sanda sun cafke 'yan daba biyar. Ɗan dabar da fuskarsa ta fito a bidiyo ya yi ƙoƙarin gudu. Wani ɗan sanda ya damƙe shi a wuya, wani kuma ya damƙe hannunsa, har aka saka masa ankwa. An kuma cafke direban motar.

Jam'iyyar adawa ta ƙalubalanci sakamakon zaɓen a kotu. Ta kai bidiyon da rahoton Usama a matsayin shaida. Alhaji Ɗanmalam bai sake magana a bainar jama'a ba.

Editan Usama ya ce masa, "Wayar hannu ta zama makamin talakawa a kan maguɗi. Amma aikinka na bin diddigi shi ne ya bayyana gaskiya."

Tambayoyi:
Me 'yan daba suka yi a ranar zaɓe?
Sun kwashe akwatunan zaɓe, sun gudu da su.
Me Alhaji Ɗanmalam ya ce a rediyo?
Ya ce bidiyoyin ƙarya ne, wanda ya yi su maƙaryaci ne.
Ta yaya Usama ya bi diddigin bidiyoyin?
Ya duba lokacin da wurin da aka ɗauki kowane bidiyo, ya kuma gano fuskar wani ɗan daba.
Me matasa suka yi bayan badaƙalar ta bazu?
Sun yi muzahara a kan titunan Gombe.
'Yan daba nawa 'yan sanda suka cafke?
Sun cafke 'yan daba biyar.

lessons.title: Firaminista a tashar hasken rana
lessons.summary: Near Niamey, the engineer Mahamane works at a huge solar plant founded three years ago with a bank loan; when the Prime Minister of Niger comes on an inspection tour, security is tightened, the workers hurry to clean the panels, Kadidiatou holds his umbrella and asks about the workers' unpaid allowance, and he promises to pay it.
lessons.text:
Mahamane injiniya ne a wani katafaren aikin samar da wutar lantarki daga hasken rana a wajen birnin Niamey. An assasa aikin shekara uku da suka wuce. Gwamnatin Nijar ta karɓi lamuni daga wani babban banki domin ta biya kuɗin aikin. Lamunin ya kai biliyoyin kuɗi, kuma za a biya shi a cikin shekara 20.

A katafaren filin aikin akwai allunan hasken rana fiye da dubu ɗari. Kowane allo yana karɓar hasken rana, yana mayar da shi wutar lantarki. Wutar tana zuwa gidaje a Niamey da ƙauyukan da ke kusa.

Wata rana aka sanar da cewa Firaministan Nijar zai kawo rangadi a wurin. Firaministan yana so ya ga yadda aikin yake tafiya. Kwana biyu kafin rangadin, aka tsaurara tsaro. Sojoji sun zo, suka tsaurara bincike a ƙofar shiga. Kowane ma'aikaci sai ya nuna katinsa.

Shugaban ma'aikata ya ce, "Ku yi hanzari! Iska ta kawo ƙura a kan allunan. Ku wanke su kafin Firaminista ya iso." Ma'aikata suka yi aiki da hanzari, suna wanke alluna da ruwa.

Ranar rangadin, Firaministan ya iso da ƙarfe goma na safe. Rana tana da zafi sosai. Wata ma'aikaciya, Kadidiatou, aka ba ta aikin riƙe masa lema. Ta riƙe lemar a kansa yayin da Mahamane yake nuna masa allunan, yana bayyana yadda suke aiki.

Firaministan ya tambaye shi, "Wuta nawa wannan wuri yake samarwa?" Mahamane ya ce, "Isasshiyar wuta ga gidaje dubu hamsin." Firaministan ya yi murmushi.

Sai wani allo ya fara fitar da hayaƙi a can gefe. Mahamane ya garzaya wurin tare da wasu ma'aikata biyu. Wata waya ce ta ƙone. Suka kashe wutar allon, suka gyara wayar. Firaministan ya kalle su, ya ce, "Na ga yadda kuka garzaya. Wannan shi ne aiki."

Kafin ya tafi, Kadidiatou ta ce, tana riƙe da lemar har yanzu, "Ranka ya daɗe, ma'aikatan wannan wuri ba su karɓi alawus ɗinsu ba har wata uku." Firaministan ya juya ga jami'ansa. Ya ce, "Me ya sa ba a biya su alawus ba?" Wani jami'i ya ce kuɗin bai iso ba tukuna.

Firaministan ya ce, "Ina so a biya kowa alawus ɗinsa kafin ƙarshen wata." Bayan sati biyu, kuɗin ya iso. Mahamane ya ce wa Kadidiatou, "Lemar da kika riƙe ta kawo mana alawus."

Tambayoyi:
Yaushe aka assasa aikin hasken rana?
An assasa shi shekara uku da suka wuce.
Ta yaya gwamnati ta biya kuɗin aikin?
Ta karɓi lamuni daga wani babban banki.
Me aka yi kwana biyu kafin rangadin?
Aka tsaurara tsaro, sojoji suka zo.
Me Kadidiatou ta riƙe wa Firaminista?
Ta riƙe masa lema.
Me Kadidiatou ta faɗa wa Firaminista?
Ta ce ma'aikata ba su karɓi alawus ɗinsu ba har wata uku.

lessons.title: Damisa a gidan namun daji
lessons.summary: At the Kano zoo, the keeper Malam Abdulrauf tells the vet Dr. Muhsina that the leopard has stopped eating; she sees a large boil under its throat, puts it to sleep with a dart, enters the cage, cuts and cleans the boil and wraps the wound, and three days later the leopard eats again.
lessons.text:
Malam Abdulrauf yana kula da dabbobi a gidan namun daji na Kano. Dabbar da ya fi so ita ce wata babbar damisa da take zaune a cikin keji a ƙarshen gidan. Ta zo daga wani daji shekaru biyar da suka wuce.

Wata safiya Malam Abdulrauf ya kai wa damisar nama, amma ba ta ci ba. Ta kwanta a kusurwar keji, ba ta motsi. Washegari ma haka. Ya jingina a jikin ƙarfen kejin yana kallonta. Ya ga tana haɗiye kamar wani abu yana mata ciwo.

Ya kira likitar dabbobi, Dr. Muhsina. Da ta zo, ita ma ta tsaya kusa da kejin, amma ba ta jingina a jiki ba. Ta ce, "Kada ka sake jingina a jikin kejin. Ka manta da abin da ya faru bara?" A bara, damisar ta kai wa wani ma'aikaci mari da tafin ƙafarta ta cikin ƙarfen kejin. Marin ya yage masa riga, ya ji masa ciwo a kafaɗa.

Dr. Muhsina ta duba damisar da madubin hangen nesa. Ta ga wani babban ƙurji a ƙasan maƙogoronta. Ta ce, "Wannan ƙurjin yana danna maƙogoronta. Shi ya sa ba ta iya haɗiye nama."

Ta harba wa damisar allurar barci da bindigar magani. Bayan minti 15, damisar ta yi barci. Malam Abdulrauf ya buɗe kejin, suka shiga a hankali. Ya ce, "Wayyo! Idan ta farka fa?" Dr. Muhsina ta ce, "Ba za ta farka ba kafin awa ɗaya."

Dr. Muhsina ta yanke ƙurjin da wuƙar likita. Wani ruwa mai wari ya fito. Sannan ta tsarkake raunin da wani magani, ta sake tsarkake shi sau biyu, domin kada ƙwayoyin cuta su shiga. Ta ce, "Idan ba mu tsarkake shi da kyau ba, ƙurjin zai dawo."

Bayan haka ta lulluɓe wuyan damisar da farin zane. Sai ta ce wa Malam Abdulrauf ya kawo bargo. Suka lulluɓe jikinta da bargon domin kada sanyi ya kama ta yayin da take barci. Suka fita, suka rufe kejin.

Bayan awa ɗaya, damisar ta tashi. Ta yi wani babban kuka, ta yi tsalle zuwa ƙofar kejin. Malam Abdulrauf ya ja da baya, ya ce, "Wayyo Allah!" Amma ƙofar a rufe take.

Kwana uku bayan haka, Malam Abdulrauf ya kai mata nama. Damisar ta ci shi duka. Ya kira Dr. Muhsina a waya, ya ce, "Damisarmu ta warke!"

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa damisar ba ta cin nama?
Domin akwai babban ƙurji a ƙasan maƙogoronta.
Me ya faru da wani ma'aikaci a bara?
Damisar ta kai masa mari da tafin ƙafarta.
Me Dr. Muhsina ta yi bayan ta yanke ƙurjin?
Ta tsarkake raunin da magani.
Me suka lulluɓe jikin damisar da shi?
Sun lulluɓe ta da bargo.
Me Malam Abdulrauf ya ce da damisar ta tashi?
Ya ce, "Wayyo Allah!"

lessons.title: Ganin watan Sallah
lessons.summary: In Sokoto, Malam Abdulhaq, who gives Qur'an commentary in Ramadan and loves the stars, takes his student Salman and his telescope out on the eve of Sallah; some elders prefer the naked eye, the Malam explains both views, the moon is seen without doubt, the people pray for the Prophet, and Salman offers to teach the youths for free and to look for the moon of the sacrifice feast.
lessons.text:
Malam Abdulhaq babban malami ne a Sokoto. A kowane watan Azumi yakan yi tafsirin Alƙur'ani a babban masallacin unguwarsu. Mutane da yawa sukan zo su saurari tafsirinsa bayan sallar la'asar. Amma ban da ilimin addini, Malam Abdulhaq yana son ilimin taurari.

Ɗalibinsa Salman yana karatun kimiyya a jami'a. Yana da wani madubin hangen nesa da ya saya da kuɗinsa. A ranar 29 ga watan Azumi, Malam Abdulhaq ya ce masa, "Yau za a iya zama jajibirin Sallah. Ka kawo madubinka, mu je mu nemi wata."

Da yamma, suka hau wani tudu a wajen gari tare da wasu dattawa. Salman ya kafa madubin. Wani dattijo ya ce, "Ni na fifita ganin wata da ido. Haka magabatanmu suka yi." Wani kuma ya ce, "Ni kuma na fifita madubi, domin yana ganin abin da ido ba ya gani."

Malam Abdulhaq ya ce, "Kowace mahanga tana da azanci. Daga mahangata, madubi ba ya maye gurbin ido. Yana taimaka wa ido ne kawai. Idan madubi ya nuna mana inda watan yake, sai mu duba da idonmu. Wannan shi ne azanci."

Rana ta faɗi. Sararin sama ya yi ja. Salman yana duba cikin madubin. Bayan minti goma, ya ce, "Malam, na gan shi! Ga shi can, sama da wannan bishiya." Malam Abdulhaq ya duba ta cikin madubin. Sannan ya kalli wurin da idonsa. Ya ce, "Na'am, na gan shi da idona ma. Babu tantama."

Dattawan ma suka duba. Kowa ya gani. Babu wanda ya yi tantama. Mutane suka yi salati ga Annabi, suka gode wa Allah. Malam Abdulhaq ya ce, "Wannan falala ce daga Allah. Gobe Sallah ce."

Da suka sauko, wani saurayi ya tambayi Salman, "Nawa kake karɓa idan ka koya mana yadda ake amfani da madubin?" Salman ya ce, "Ba zan karɓi ko sisi ba. Zan koya muku lillahi." Malam Abdulhaq ya yi murmushi, ya ce, "Ilimin da aka koyar lillahi yana da falala mai yawa."

Salman ya ce, "Malam, bayan wata biyu za mu nemi watan Zulhajji, domin mu san ranar layya." Malam ya ce, "Haka ne. Idan muka gan shi, sai mu ƙirga kwana goma zuwa ranar layya." Mutanen suka watse suna salati, suna shirin jajibirin Sallah.

Tambayoyi:
Me Malam Abdulhaq yake yi a watan Azumi?
Yakan yi tafsirin Alƙur'ani a babban masallaci.
Me dattijo na farko ya fifita?
Ya fifita ganin wata da ido.
Me Malam Abdulhaq ya ce game da madubi?
Ya ce madubi yana taimaka wa ido ne kawai, ba ya maye gurbinsa.
Me mutane suka yi bayan sun ga watan?
Suka yi salati ga Annabi, suka gode wa Allah.
Me ya sa Salman zai nemi watan Zulhajji?
Domin su san ranar layya.

lessons.title: Waya, tauraron ɗan Adam da 'yan mata
lessons.summary: A newspaper column by the activist Malama Hasiba: young girls from poor families are tricked with promises of work in Italy, cross the desert with illegal migrants, and are forced into prostitution and abused in Libya; one girl, Amatullah, sends her location from a hidden phone, satellites and the police find the house, twenty girls are freed, and a court orders the traffickers to pay compensation.
lessons.text:
Daga Malama Hasiba, mai rajin kare haƙƙin mata

Ni mai rajin kare haƙƙin mata ce tun shekara 15. A wannan lokaci na ga yadda fasaha take canza yaƙi da fataucin mutane. A yau zan ba da labarin wata yarinya da za mu kira Amatullah.

Amatullah 'yar wani talaka ce a wani ƙauye. Iyayenta marasa galihu ne: ba su da kuɗi, ba su da wani babban mutum da zai taimake su. Wata mata ta zo ta ce wa iyayen, "Akwai aikin gidan abinci a Italiya. Yarinyarku za ta riƙa aiko muku da kuɗi kowane wata." Iyayen suka yarda.

Amatullah ta bi motar baƙin haure ta cikin hamada zuwa Libiya. A cikin motar akwai baƙin haure fiye da 40, maza da mata. Sun shafe kwana goma a hamada, da ruwa kaɗan.

Da suka isa Libiya, sai aka kai 'yan matan wani gida. Aka gaya musu cewa babu aikin gidan abinci. Aka tursasa su yin karuwanci domin su biya kuɗin tafiyarsu. Duk wadda ta ƙi, sai a musguna mata: a hana ta abinci, a doke ta, a kulle ta a ɗaki. Masu fataucin sun ci gaba da musguna musu kowace rana.

Amma Amatullah ta ɓoye wata ƙaramar waya a cikin takalminta. Wata rana da dare ta tura wa ƙungiyarmu saƙo da wurin da take, ta hanyar tauraron ɗan Adam. Mun aika wa 'yan sandan Libiya wurin. Sun duba hotunan tauraron ɗan Adam, suka gane gidan.

Bayan kwana uku 'yan sanda suka kai samame gidan. Sun ƴantar da 'yan mata 20 daga Najeriya da Nijar. Wasu daga cikinsu sun shafe shekara biyu ana tursasa su. An kama masu fataucin biyar.

Ƙungiyarmu ta taimaka aka mayar da 'yan matan gida. A Najeriya, kotu ta yanke wa masu fataucin hukuncin ɗauri. Kotun ta kuma umarce su da su biya kowace yarinya diyya. Diyyar ba za ta mayar da abin da suka rasa ba, amma za ta taimaka musu su fara sabuwar rayuwa.

Ra'ayina shi ne: fasaha ita kaɗai ba za ta ƴantar da mutane ba. Dole iyaye su san cewa masu fataucin suna neman marasa galihu. Babu aikin da ake samu a Turai ta hanyar tafiyar baƙin haure ta cikin hamada. Ku kare 'ya'yanku.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa iyayen Amatullah suka yarda ta tafi?
Domin wata mata ta ce akwai aikin gidan abinci a Italiya.
Me aka tursasa 'yan matan yi a Libiya?
Aka tursasa su yin karuwanci.
Ta yaya Amatullah ta nemi taimako?
Ta tura saƙo da wurin da take daga wata ƙaramar waya.
'Yan mata nawa 'yan sanda suka ƴantar?
Sun ƴantar da 'yan mata 20.
Me kotu ta umarci masu fataucin su yi?
Ta umarce su da su biya kowace yarinya diyya.

lessons.title: Aljan ko cuta?
lessons.summary: In Katsina, fourteen-year-old Safwa starts falling down and shaking; her grandmother blames a jinn, a malam recites and spits on water for her, and her father Malam Manu, who loves her, thinks of marrying her off now that she has come of age; her mother Malama Inno takes her to Dr. Awwal, who explains epilepsy and gives a bitter medicine, and Safwa goes back to school.
lessons.text:
Safwa yarinya ce 'yar shekara 14 a Katsina. Tana aji uku a makarantar sakandare. Ita ce 'yar fari ta Malam Manu da Malama Inno, kuma mahaifinta ya ƙaunace ta tun ranar da aka haife ta.

Wata rana tana wanke kwanuka, sai ta faɗi a ƙasa. Jikinta ya riƙa motsi da ƙarfi, kumfa yana fitowa daga bakinta. Bayan minti biyu ta tashi, ba ta tuna abin da ya faru ba. Bayan sati ɗaya, abin ya sake faruwa a makaranta.

Kakarta ta ce, "Wannan aljan ne. Aljan ya shiga jikinta." Ta kira wani malami. Malamin ya karanta addu'o'i a kan ruwa, sannan ya tofa a cikin ruwan, ya ce Safwa ta sha. Ya ce, "Duk wanda aljan ya kama, sai a tofa masa addu'a." Ya tofa a kan ruwa kwana bakwai, amma faɗuwar ba ta daina ba.

Wasu dangi suka ce wa Malam Manu, "Yarinyar ta balaga. Ka aurar da ita kawai. Idan ta yi aure, aljan zai bar ta." Malam Manu ya damu. Ya ƙaunace ta, ba ya so ya aurar da ita tun tana ƙarama. Amma bai san abin da zai yi ba.

Malama Inno ta ce, "Kafin ka aurar da ita, bari mu je asibiti." Ta rufe kanta da mayafinta, ta kama hannun Safwa, suka tafi babban asibitin Katsina.

Likita, Dr. Awwal, ya saurari labarinsu. Ya yi wa Safwa gwaje gwajen ƙwaƙwalwa da wata na'ura. Sannan ya ce, "Wannan ba aljan ba ne. Cuta ce ta ƙwaƙwalwa da ake kira farfaɗiya. Ba ta da alaƙa da balaga ko aure. Tana iya kama kowa, babba ko yaro."

Malama Inno ta gyara mayafinta, ta ce, "Ana iya magance ta?" Likitan ya ce, "Na'am. Za ta riƙa shan wannan magani kowace safiya da kowane dare." Ya ba ta ƙwayoyin magani. Da Safwa ta sha na farko, ta ce, "Wayyo, ɗacinsa ya yi yawa!" Likitan ya yi dariya. Ya ce, "Ɗacin maganin ya fi ɗacin cutar sauƙi."

Safwa ta sha maganin kowace rana, duk da ɗacinsa. Bayan wata uku, ba ta sake faɗuwa ba. Malam Manu ya ce, "Na gode wa Allah da ban aurar da ke ba." Safwa ta koma makaranta. Yanzu tana cewa za ta zama likita.

Tambayoyi:
Me kakar Safwa ta ce game da faɗuwarta?
Ta ce aljan ne ya shiga jikinta.
Me malamin ya yi a kan ruwa?
Ya karanta addu'o'i, ya tofa a cikin ruwan.
Me dangi suka ce wa Malam Manu?
Sun ce yarinyar ta balaga, ya aurar da ita.
Wace cuta Dr. Awwal ya ce Safwa take da ita?
Ya ce cutar farfaɗiya ce, cuta ta ƙwaƙwalwa.
Me Safwa ta ce game da maganin?
Ta ce ɗacinsa ya yi yawa.

lessons.title: Gasar kimiyya a Kaduna
lessons.summary: At a school science fair in Kaduna, the friends Najla and Nuhaila show with waina and a chocolate cake how yeast makes dough rise; they write their poster in ink, the jealous Fahim spills water on it, Nuhaila wants revenge but Najla refuses, they rewrite it in yellow and other colours, win, and their kindness turns Fahim into a friend.
lessons.text:
Najla da Nuhaila ƙawaye ne tun suna aji ɗaya. Abotarsu ta shahara a makarantarsu ta sakandare a Kaduna. A kowane aiki suna tare. Da aka sanar da gasar kimiyya ta makarantu, sai suka ce za su shiga tare.

Najla ta ce, "Bari mu nuna yadda yisti yake sa fulawa ta tashi." Nuhaila ta ce, "Mu yi da abinci biyu: waina da kek na cakulan." Mahaifiyar Najla tana sayar da waina a ƙofar gidansu kowace safiya, saboda haka sun san yadda ake yin waina.

Suka yi gwaji a gida. Suka kwaɓa shinkafa da yisti a kwano ɗaya. A wani kwano kuma suka kwaɓa shinkafa ba tare da yisti ba. Bayan awa huɗu, abin da ke cikin kwanon farko ya tashi sama. Suka auna hauhawar kowane kwano da rula. Hauhawar kwanon da yake da yisti ta kai rabin kwanon. Sannan suka yi kek na cakulan iri biyu, ɗaya da yisti, ɗaya ba yisti.

Amma farashin cakulan ya yi tsada. Nuhaila ta ce, "Hauhawar farashin cakulan ta fi hauhawar kek ɗinmu!" Suka yi dariya, suka haɗa kuɗinsu suka saya.

Suka rubuta bayanin gwajin a kan wata babbar takarda da tawada baƙa. Sun yi zane da kala kala na tawada: ja, kore da shuɗi. Takardar ta yi kyau sosai.

A ranar gasar, wani ɗalibi mai suna Fahim yana kusa da teburinsu. Shi ma ya kawo nasa aikin, amma bai yi kyau ba. Da 'yan matan suka je ɗaukar ruwa, Fahim ya zuba ruwa a kan takardarsu. Tawadar ta zube, rubutun ya ɓace.

Nuhaila ta yi fushi. Ta ce, "Ni zan yi ramuwa! Zan zuba ruwa a kan nasa aikin ma." Najla ta riƙe hannunta. Ta ce, "A'a. Ramuwa ba za ta gyara takardarmu ba. Mu sake rubutawa kawai."

Ba su da sauran tawada baƙa, sai tawada mai launin rawaya. Suka sake rubutu da tawadar rawaya a kan wata takarda kore. Rubutun rawaya ya fito sarai, kowa yana iya karanta shi daga nesa. Suka ajiye waina da kek na cakulan a gaban takardar.

Alƙalan gasar suka ɗanɗana waina da cakulan, suka karanta rubutun rawaya, suka auna hauhawar kek ɗin. Najla da Nuhaila suka ci kyautar farko.

Bayan gasar, Fahim ya zo ya ce, "Ku yi haƙuri. Ni na zuba ruwan." Najla ta ba shi waina. Ta ce, "Mun yafe maka. Zo mu ci tare." Daga ranar, abotar Najla da Nuhaila ta zama abotar mutum uku.

Tambayoyi:
Me Najla da Nuhaila suka so su nuna a gasar?
Sun so su nuna yadda yisti yake sa fulawa ta tashi.
Wane irin abinci biyu suka yi?
Sun yi waina da kek na cakulan.
Me Fahim ya yi wa takardarsu?
Ya zuba ruwa a kan takardarsu, tawadar ta zube.
Me ya sa Najla ta ƙi ramuwa?
Domin ramuwa ba za ta gyara takardarsu ba.
Da wace tawada suka sake rubutu?
Sun sake rubutu da tawada mai launin rawaya.
